title: Vietnam Coastal Macro Report 2026
dek: Capital flows out of the constrained primary markets and into coastal secondary cities: FDI registrations, land-use approvals and domestic wealth formation, 2019–2026.
quote: Vietnam's coastal secondary cities are absorbing institutional capital that the primary markets can no longer place, on infrastructure delivery rather than sentiment.

title: Vietnam Tail Risk Analysis
dek: The four exposures we model against a Vietnam coastal position — credit tightening, currency, typhoon frequency, and single-buyer tourism concentration — and what each costs at the fifth percentile.
quote: The binding constraint is not demand but the developer credit channel; every scenario we run degrades through it first.

title: Post-Pandemic Hospitality Yield Shifts
dek: Operating data from eleven coastal estates: how ADR, occupancy and staffing cost per key moved between 2019 and 2025, and where low-density stock now sits against hotel product.
quote: Low-density estates hold rate through the shoulder season; the volume-led hotel format recovers occupancy first and rate last.
